layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

layers.text: Camera: head-and-shoulders bust portrait for a game interface, level three-quarter view, the character turned slightly to the right (south-east) and looking at the viewer, head and upper chest filling most of the square, centred on a transparent background. The bust ends cleanly at the chest; nothing else is in the image.

Faction: cheerful sugary confectionery, bright, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy cotton-candy pink sugar glaze and frosting, colour #ffb8d8, shaded with a deeper rose pink #e58fb5; matte marshmallow white and cream; warm caramel, pale biscuit wafer and dark chocolate brown; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface; a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a little pale mint green trim.

layers.text: Subject: Confectioner portrait, a close-up of the head and shoulders of a chunky cute living caramel sweet who is a pastry cook: a big round head of glossy golden caramel brown with pink frosting and tiny sprinkles dripping over its top, big round brass goggles with pale lenses over its eyes and a small friendly smile; a tall white puffy baker's hat on top; the top of a white apron on its shoulders; and a balloon whisk with a pale wire head and a pink handle raised beside the head; no crown, no coat and no hair.
A close-up bust: the caramel head with its goggles and baker's hat fills the whole square; no legs.
